Anya (PM): Quick sync — need to prioritize Optimize toolkit items for next sprint: quantization profiles, adaptive batching, request-level caching. Customers asking for cost wins + low-risk rollouts. Thoughts?
Matt (Infra Eng): Prefer batching first if it reduces GPU slots used. Effort = ~2pm for prototype, 4pm to harden.
Dina (ML Eng): Quantization unlocks big cost savings but high QA for regressions. Risk: output quality + evals needed. Effort ~3-5pm.
Kevin (SRE): Caching (prefix/KV) could cut tokens served by 20-40% for chat workflows. Low infra risk, ops overhead for invalidation.
Sam (Sales): Big customer asks: finance and search app teams want quantization recommendations + a rollout plan. They'd sign for dedicated if we show 30% cost drop.
Elena (Data Sci): We can measure impact quickly with eval sets. Quick back-of-envelope: batching => -15% cost, quant => -35% (varies), caching => -20% for top endpoints.
Anya (PM): Can we do a quick RICE to compare? Impact=cost savings+user retention, Reach=#customers affected, Confidence=how sure we are, Effort=team-months. I'll throw numbers.
Anya (PM): ```
Quantization: Reach=40, Impact=35, Confidence=60, Effort=4 => RICE = (40*35*0.6)/4 = 210
Batching: Reach=70, Impact=15, Confidence=80, Effort=2 => RICE = (70*15*0.8)/2 = 420
Caching: Reach=50, Impact=20, Confidence=70, Effort=3 => RICE = (50*20*0.7)/3 = 233
```
Dina (ML Eng): Those numbers match what I'd expect for quick prioritization. Batching wins in RICE but quant has higher per-unit savings and sales pull.
Matt (Infra Eng): Sequencing note: batching needs runtime hooks + telemetry. Caching needs route-level invalidation support; quant needs model conversion pipelines.
Kevin (SRE): Operational risk ranking: caching (low), batching (medium), quant (high). We should define rollback and canary criteria per feature.
Sam (Sales): Proposal: ship batching v1 (low-risk), then quantization pilot for internal + 1 customer, then caching improvements. Customers happy with that.
Elena (Data Sci): Launch criteria suggestions: automated eval suite passing (no >2% quality regression for critical prompts), latency impact <10% p95 for batching, reproducible cost benchmark.
Anya (PM): Draft launch checklist for each:
Anya (PM): - Spec PR
Anya (PM): - RICE + stakeholder signoff
Anya (PM): - Eval harness results
Anya (PM): - Canary plan + rollback
Dina (ML Eng): I'll write quant pilot plan and evals.
Matt (Infra Eng): I'll prototype batching + add metrics (tokens/sec, batch-size distribution).
Kevin (SRE): I'll draft canary playbook and alert thresholds.
Anya (PM): Ok slate for next sprint: batching + quant pilot experiments + spec for caching invalidation. We'll re-score after pilot. :raised_hands:
